legend: Swing is opening a pancake factory! A good pancake factory must be good at flattening things, so Swing is going to test his new equipment on 2D matrices.
Swing is given an n×n$$$n \times n$$$ matrix M$$$M$$$ containing positive integers. He has q$$$q$$$ queries to ask you.

For each query, he gives you four integers x1$$$x_1$$$, y1$$$y_1$$$, x2$$$x_2$$$, y2$$$y_2$$$ and asks you to flatten the submatrix bounded by (x1,y1)$$$(x_1, y_1)$$$ and (x2,y2)$$$(x_2, y_2)$$$ into an array A$$$A$$$. Formally, A=[M(x1,y1),M(x1,y1+1),…,M(x1,y2),M(x1+1,y1),M(x1+1,y1+1),…,M(x2,y2)]$$$A = [M_{(x1,y1)}, M_{(x1,y1+1)}, \ldots, M_{(x1,y2)}, M_{(x1+1,y1)}, M_{(x1+1,y1+1)}, \ldots, M_{(x2,y2)}]$$$.

The following image depicts the flattening of a submatrix bounded by the red dotted lines. The orange arrows denote the direction that the elements of the submatrix are appended to the back of A$$$A$$$, and A$$$A$$$ is shown at the bottom of the image.
Afterwards, he asks you for the value of ∑|A|i=1Ai⋅i$$$\sum_{i=1}^{|A|} A_i \cdot i$$$ (sum of Ai⋅i$$$A_i \cdot i$$$ over all i$$$i$$$).
input: The first line contains an integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤103$$$1 \leq t \leq 10^3$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n≤2000,1≤q≤106$$$1 \leq n \leq 2000, 1 \leq q \leq 10^6$$$) — the length of M$$$M$$$ and the number of queries.

The following n$$$n$$$ lines contain n$$$n$$$ integers each, the i$$$i$$$'th of which contains M(i,1),M(i,2),…,M(i,n)$$$M_{(i,1)}, M_{(i,2)}, \ldots, M_{(i,n)}$$$ (1≤M(i,j)≤106$$$1 \leq M_{(i, j)} \leq 10^6$$$).

The following q$$$q$$$ lines contain four integers x1$$$x_1$$$, y1$$$y_1$$$, x2$$$x_2$$$, and y2$$$y_2$$$ (1≤x1≤x2≤n,1≤y1≤y2≤n$$$1 \leq x_1 \leq x_2 \leq n, 1 \leq y_1 \leq y_2 \leq n$$$) — the bounds of the query.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 2000$$$2000$$$ and the sum of q$$$q$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 106$$$10^6$$$.
output: For each test case, output the results of the q$$$q$$$ queries on a new line.
note: In the second query of the first test case, A=[9,5,5,2]$$$A = [9, 5, 5, 2]$$$. Therefore, the sum is 1⋅9+2⋅5+3⋅5+4⋅2=42$$$1 \cdot 9 + 2 \cdot 5 + 3 \cdot 5 + 4 \cdot 2 = 42$$$.

legend.ai: Swing 正在开一家煎饼工厂！一家优秀的煎饼工厂必须擅长将东西展平，因此 Swing 打算在二维矩阵上测试他的新设备。
Swing 得到了一个包含正整数的 n×n$$$n \times n$$$ 矩阵 M$$$M$$$。他有 q$$$q$$$ 个查询要向你提出。
下图展示了由红色虚线界定的子矩阵的展平过程。橙色箭头表示子矩阵中的元素追加到 A$$$A$$$ 末尾的方向，而 A$$$A$$$ 显示在图像底部。
之后，他询问你 ∑|A|i=1Ai⋅i$$$\sum_{i=1}^{|A|} A_i \cdot i$$$ 的值(即对所有 i$$$i$$$ 求 Ai⋅i$$$A_i \cdot i$$$ 的和)。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤103$$$1 \leq t \leq 10^3$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$(1≤n≤2000,1≤q≤106$$$1 \leq n \leq 2000, 1 \leq q \leq 10^6$$$)——M$$$M$$$ 的长度以及查询的数量。
接下来的 q$$$q$$$ 行每行包含四个整数 x1$$$x_1$$$、y1$$$y_1$$$、x2$$$x_2$$$ 和 y2$$$y_2$$$(1≤x1≤x2≤n,1≤y1≤y2≤n$$$1 \leq x_1 \leq x_2 \leq n, 1 \leq y_1 \leq y_2 \leq n$$$)——查询的范围。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，在新的一行输出 q$$$q$$$ 个查询的结果。
